tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page and map-land ground. Text sits on this in body copy.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised panels, cards, sheets, dialogs and floating controls above the map.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Sunken fields, hover wash, table header, skeleton blocks.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and toasts. Text on it is on-inverse.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface-100, surface-200 and surface-300.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and helper text on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholder text and disabled labels on surface-100 and surface-200. Never for essential information.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links on surface-100 and surface-200. Always underlined.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers, card outlines, table rules. Not for control edges.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, checkboxes, segmented controls. 3:1 against its grounds.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring. Two pixels, solid, offset by two pixels, on every surface.

tokens.name: river
tokens.usage: Primary action fill and brand blue. Text on it is on-river.

tokens.name: river-hover
tokens.usage: Pressed and hover state of river fills.

tokens.name: river-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind selected rows, info callouts and soft badges.

tokens.name: on-river
tokens.usage: Text and icons on river and river-hover.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Restrained highlight for sources, destinations and the one important action on screen. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent badges and selected source or outlet rows.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-hover.

tokens.name: tussock
tokens.usage: Tussock and olive land cover and decorative fills. Not for text.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Forest land cover on the map and success icons. Pair with a label.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Bare rock and scree on the map. Not for text.

tokens.name: earth
tokens.usage: Terrain brown for relief shading and elevation labels on the map.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and success-soft. Always paired with a check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success callouts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and warning-soft. Always paired with a triangle icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning callouts and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and danger-soft. Always paired with a cross icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error callouts and badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Information text and icons on surface-100, surface-200 and info-soft. Always paired with an i icon.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of information callouts.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Base land colour of the map canvas.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Lakes, estuaries and sea fill on the map.

tokens.name: map-relief
tokens.usage: Gentle hillshade tint over land.

tokens.name: map-contour
tokens.usage: Fine contour lines. Decorative on the map and in backgrounds; keep at hairline weight.

tokens.name: map-contour-index
tokens.usage: Every fifth contour, slightly stronger.

tokens.name: map-grid
tokens.usage: Map grid lines and grid references in the Topo50 manner. Hairline weight only.

tokens.name: map-river-context
tokens.usage: Rivers that are not selected. Recessive on purpose; thin line weight keeps them readable and the selected states carry meaning.

tokens.name: map-river-selected
tokens.usage: Selected waterway. Four pixels, solid, brightest blue on the map.

tokens.name: map-main-channel
tokens.usage: Longest path to the source. Accent rust, not river blue, so it reads on the catchment. Three pixels, solid, with a cream casing.

tokens.name: map-upstream
tokens.usage: Upstream network and tributaries feeding the selection. Two pixels, solid.

tokens.name: map-downstream
tokens.usage: Downstream route to the sea. Three pixels, solid with chevrons, so it reads without colour.

tokens.name: map-main-halo
tokens.usage: Cream casing around the longest path so it cuts through catchment green.

tokens.name: map-upstream-halo
tokens.usage: Soft casing under the catchment network so it reads against the sheet without a polygon.

tokens.name: map-catchment-stroke
tokens.usage: Catchment boundary. Two pixels, dashed.

tokens.name: map-catchment-fill
tokens.usage: Catchment fill, with a diagonal hatch for non-colour distinction.

tokens.name: map-source
tokens.usage: Source markers and leader lines.

tokens.name: map-outlet
tokens.usage: Outlet and destination markers.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind dialogs.

tokens.name: profile-fill
tokens.usage: Area under an elevation profile.
